stories.title: Wrestlers added to AEW Women's Blood & Guts match
stories.tldr: AEW has finalized the lineups for the upcoming women's Blood & Guts match by adding newly crowned TBS Champion Queen Aminata and former titleholder Persephone to opposing sides. Persephone demanded a rematch and challenged Aminata to fill the final open slots on their respective teams following a surprise title change on Dynamite. The six-on-six clash will air live on Wednesday, November 4, amid critiques regarding the familiar faces and rushed build for the women's war.

stories.title: Mercedes Mone vs Marina Shafir set for AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Marina Shafir has officially earned a shot at the AEW Women’s World Championship, where she will challenge titleholder Mercedes Mone at the upcoming AEW Full Gear pay-per-view. The high-stakes match was made official following escalating tensions between the two competitors on recent episodes of Dynamite and Collision. The rivalry intensified when Shafir called out the champion and withstood a flurry of slaps without flinching, setting the stage for their upcoming championship clash on November 14 in Phoenix, Arizona.

stories.title: Andrade vs Tommaso Ciampa AEW National Title rematch set for Collision
stories.tldr: Andrade El Idolo will defend the AEW National Championship against Tommaso Ciampa in a high-stakes rematch on the upcoming episode of AEW Collision. The match stems from their critically acclaimed encounter at AEW WrestleDream where Andrade successfully retained his title. Ciampa subsequently earned another title opportunity after attacking the champion and scoring an impressive victory on television. This special edition of Collision will emanate live from Chris Jericho's Rock N Wrestling Rager cruise while docked in Miami, Florida.

stories.title: Samoa Joe teases changes to The Opps on AEW Collision
stories.tldr: Samoa Joe recently hinted at major changes within The Opps during a backstage promo on AEW Collision, appearing to question HOOK's leadership during Joe's recent absence. Joe addressed a shift in the group's perception and warned the AEW roster that the dynamic of the faction is about to change. Notably, group members Anthony Bowens and Action Andretti were absent from the segment.

stories.title: Adam Copeland on wrestling in Maple Leaf Gardens vs Wembley
stories.tldr: AEW star Adam Copeland recently revealed that wrestling at Maple Leaf Gardens meant more to him than performing at any other venue in the world, including Wembley Stadium. Growing up watching wrestling at the historic arena, Copeland thought stepping into its ring was an impossible dream, especially after his nine-year retirement. However, a collaborative effort with Scott D'Amore made the appearance possible following Copeland's transition to AEW. With his retirement officially set for 2027, Copeland has nearly completed his career bucket list, with only the Tokyo Dome left as a potential final milestone.

stories.title: Jake Roberts advises Tony Khan to loosen the reins in AEW
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Jake Roberts recently discussed his current career status and shared his thoughts on the creative direction of All Elite Wrestling. Now re-signed with WWE and enjoying life, Roberts praised AEW President Tony Khan as a sweet guy but suggested that he needs to loosen the reins and take more advice. Roberts also expressed his fondness for working with Lance Archer, calling their pairing perfect and stating that Archer is an unbelievable talent who never got the break he deserved.

stories.title: Anthony Bowens dresses as Max Caster for Halloween
stories.tldr: Anthony Bowens celebrated Halloween by sharing a humorous video impersonating his former tag team partner, Max Caster, complete with a fake mustache, microphone, and signature catchphrases. The lighthearted impersonation comes at an interesting time given their history in The Acclaimed and Caster recently stepping away from wrestling following a TNA controversy. Despite the recent backstage drama surrounding Caster, Bowens kept the tribute purely comedic and committed fully to the bit.

stories.title: Bryce Remsburg compares refereeing in indies vs AEW
stories.tldr: AEW referee Bryce Remsburg recently discussed the major adjustments he had to make transitioning from the independent circuit to television wrestling. Having spent 17 years refereeing on the indies, Remsburg described joining AEW in 2019 as moving from a bachelor's degree to a master's program. The biggest challenge was adapting to wearing an earpiece to receive live instructions from producers, agents, and Tony Khan. He noted that the empty arena era during the COVID-19 pandemic ultimately helped him gain the confidence needed to master television refereeing.

stories.title: Chris Jericho reacts to cameo role in Dexter: Resurrection
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho made a surprise cameo in the season two premiere of Dexter: Resurrection as a serial killer named Emmett Bell, also known as the Midnight Mangler. Jericho expressed his excitement about joining the show on Facebook while jokingly complaining that his character was robbed because Dexter Morgan ambushed him from behind. The new season, which features a star-studded cast including Michael C. Hall, Brian Cox, and Uma Thurman, airs weekly through January 2027. Meanwhile, Jericho is scheduled to appear on AEW Collision live from his upcoming wrestling cruise in November 2026.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy details worst injury of his career
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy recently revealed the most severe injuries of his professional wrestling career during an appearance on The Rizzuto Show. He detailed a terrifying incident where a knee to the face broke his orbital bone and sinus cavity, causing him to vomit blood because it drained into his stomach. Cassidy also recounted a separate, bizarre shoulder dislocation where the joint was driven into his body, requiring general anesthesia and multiple medical staff to pull it back into place.

stories.title: Billy Gunn comments on his sons following his pro wrestling footsteps
stories.tldr: AEW star Billy Gunn recently opened up about the unique experience of sharing the wrestling industry with his sons, Austin and Colten Gunn. During an interview with Inside The Ropes, Gunn discussed their contrasting personalities, how their memorable betrayal storyline came together, and his initial reluctance for them to enter the business. Despite wanting them to pursue other paths, he ultimately gave his blessing after they completed their education and proved their natural talent in the ring.

stories.title: Darby Allin pays tribute to PAC at CMLL event
stories.tldr: Darby Allin recently made his much-anticipated CMLL debut in Mexico. During his marquee match against Hechicero, Allin paid a touching tribute to the late PAC by carrying a custom skateboard. Ultimately, Hechicero defeated the AEW star to exact revenge for their previous encounter on AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Viewership Drops Against World Series
stories.tldr: The October 28 episode of AEW Dynamite averaged 620,000 viewers on TBS, seeing a decrease from the previous week's 661,000 viewers. The show also experienced a slight dip in the 18 to 49 demographic, dropping to a 0.14 rating from a 0.15 the week prior. This episode faced major sports competition, airing directly against Game 5 of the World Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and Tampa Bay Rays. Additionally, the broadcast was simulcast on HBO Max, though viewership data for that platform remains unavailable.

stories.title: Backstage Details on Komander's Current AEW Absence
stories.tldr: AEW and CMLL star Komander has been absent from television since early September due to an undisclosed injury. Dave Meltzer of the Wrestling Observer Newsletter reported the setback, though there is internal optimism within AEW that the high-flying luchador will make his return soon. His last AEW appearance was a September loss to Nick Wayne on Collision, followed by a pair of matches for CMLL later that month.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov Reflects on Joining AEW and Entering the Continental Classic
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov has shed light on how quickly his transition to All Elite Wrestling came together after a visa delay followed his WWE departure. He explained that feeling unfulfilled in his previous role prompted him to follow his gut instinct toward new opportunities. Furthermore, Dragunov provided specific logistical details for the upcoming Continental Classic, while strongly campaigning for his inclusion in the tournament.

stories.title: Former WBD Executive Doubts Skydance Will Pick Up AEW Option Year
stories.tldr: Despite Tony Khan's recent optimism following meetings with Skydance leadership, a former Warner Bros. Discovery executive warns that AEW could face trouble with its upcoming option year. The source indicates that Skydance may not renew the option unless AEW diversifies its content beyond traditional wrestling programming. While Khan has expressed excitement about his talks with David Ellison, it remains unclear what specific additional programming Skydance might be demanding from the promotion.

stories.title: TV series in development based on Chris Jericho's early career
stories.tldr: AEW star Chris Jericho recently revealed that a television series based on his 2007 autobiography, A Lion's Tale, is currently moving toward the pilot phase. The project will focus on the early years of his professional wrestling career and his global journey before making his major promotion debut. While joking that Brad Pitt is too old to portray him, Jericho teased that an unnamed actor from the comedy series Letterkenny is being considered for the lead role due to a strong facial resemblance.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa attempts RKO on AEW star in Randy Orton mix-up
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa revived his running gag of attempting to ambush Randy Orton with an RKO while visiting Orton's hometown of St. Louis, Missouri. However, the AEW star mistakenly targeted fellow roster member Kyle Fletcher from behind in the trainer's room. The botched attack sent Ciampa crashing onto a trainer's table instead, leaving a confused Fletcher questioning the bizarre encounter. This ongoing joke originated during Ciampa's time in WWE and clearly continues to follow him in his new promotion.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam defends Ric Flair's lifestyle and drinking habits
stories.tldr: Rob Van Dam has come to the defense of Ric Flair following the wrestling legend's recent health scares and falls. Speaking on his podcast, RVD argued that the seventy-seven year old Flair has earned the right to live life on his own terms even if it shortens his lifespan. Van Dam compared the situation to the movie The Wrestler and drew from his past experiences dealing with addiction in friends like Sabu. While acknowledging that Flair's lifestyle causes pain to his family, RVD believes he should be allowed to make his own choices.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy reflects on PAC rivalry and AEW difficult period
stories.tldr: In a recent interview, Orange Cassidy named PAC as his greatest career rival while reflecting on their extensive history in the ring together. Cassidy also addressed the emotional atmosphere within the locker room following the recent deaths of PAC and Andy Williams. He explained that the strong support system among the talent has been essential in helping everyone navigate this difficult period of grief together.

stories.title: Bobby Lashley announces $10,000 high school wrestling challenge
stories.tldr: AEW star and amateur wrestling veteran Bobby Lashley has announced an ambitious plan to offer a $10,000 challenge to high school wrestling teams. During a recent visit to Junction City to support the local squad, Lashley stated his intention to challenge any student in the room to a takedown for a cash prize directed toward the team. While the initiative highlights his ongoing commitment to amateur wrestling, no official confirmation has been released regarding the rollout of the challenge.

stories.title: Young Bucks praise Tony Khan as AEW tag champions
stories.tldr: Newly crowned AEW World Tag Team Champions the Young Bucks recently expressed deep appreciation for AEW CEO Tony Khan. During a recent episode of Being the Elite, Matt and Nick Jackson reflected on their career trajectory and shared how much Khan has positively impacted their professional and personal lives. Nick stated that he would do anything for Khan and feels the executive does not receive enough praise, while Matt recalled telling Khan that he truly changed his life.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown and AEW Dynamite scheduled head-to-head on New Year's Day
stories.tldr: WWE has decided against altering its schedule to counterprogram AEW on New Year's Day 2027. Instead of going live, WWE will tape the January 1 episode of SmackDown on December 28 in Tampa to give talent the holiday off. Internal expectations suggest the taped holiday broadcast may see lower ratings anyway, but management remains confident despite the upcoming head-to-head clash with a live AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov expresses interest in competing in AEW's Continental Classic
stories.tldr: Ilja Dragunov has made an immediate impact since arriving in All Elite Wrestling. In a recent digital interview, the former WWE star expressed his strong interest in competing in the upcoming Continental Classic tournament. He also took the opportunity to highlight the grueling nature of the tournament and teased a future match against former winner Eddie Kingston.

stories.title: Queen Aminata comments on winning AEW TBS Championship
stories.tldr: Following her TBS Championship win on Fright Night Dynamite, Queen Aminata shared emotional reactions on social media. She posted a touching tribute to her late father, celebrated with a photo holding her new title, and praised the AEW women's locker room for coming out to the ring to celebrate with her.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show reviews AEW Dynamite and WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Bryan and Vinny returned with a new episode breaking down the latest AEW Dynamite and WWE NXT broadcasts. The review covered the ongoing build toward major upcoming events like Blood and Guts, Full Gear, and Anarchy in the Arena. Additionally, the hosts critiqued NXT for what they described as one of the worst built Premium Live Events in wrestling history. The episode also featured general Halloween-themed frivolity and assorted discussions.

stories.title: Jack Perry health update following AEW Dynamite bumps
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher defeated Jack Perry on AEW Dynamite to earn a World Championship match against Will Ospreay at Full Gear. However, the hard-hitting encounter featured several brutal bumps that raised immediate concern for Perry's physical well-being. Fortunately, backstage updates confirm that Perry avoided serious injury and is only dealing with heavy soreness.

stories.title: AEW Fright Night Collision match lineup update
stories.tldr: Following the initial announcement of Ilja Dragunov facing The Beast Mortos, AEW has finalized the complete card for Saturday's Fright Night Collision following the tapings in St. Louis. The newly revealed matches feature Tommaso Ciampa against Matt Sydal, The Hurt Syndicate in a handicap match, and multiple other bouts rounding out the Halloween special.

stories.title: Queen Aminata wins the TBS Championship on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Queen Aminata captured her first major singles title by defeating Persephone to win the AEW TBS Championship in the main event of the October 28 Fright Night Dynamite special in St. Louis, Missouri. Aminata overcame repeated interference from Britt Baker, who was dressed as Miss Trunchbull from the movie Matilda and struck the challenger with the title belt during the match. Despite Baker's outside help and Persephone's targeted attacks on her neck, Aminata kicked out of a top-rope moonsault, delivered a headbutt, and hit her signature running knee strike to secure the pinfall. The emotional victory ended Persephone's 60-day championship reign and concluded the show with a celebration featuring confetti, pyrotechnics, and members of the women's locker room coming out to congratulate the new champion.

stories.title: Will Ospreay vs. Kyle Fletcher set for AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Kyle Fletcher has earned an AEW World Championship match against Will Ospreay at the upcoming Full Gear pay-per-view on November 14, 2026, in Phoenix, Arizona. Fletcher secured the opportunity following a hard-fought victory over Jack Perry on the Fright Night edition of Dynamite, backed by fellow Don Callis Family members. The challenger quickly pointed to his past singles victory over Ospreay at Full Gear in 2024 and a recent tag team win as proof that he can dethrone the champion. Before they collide for the gold, both competitors will first have to survive the brutal men's Blood and Guts match on the November 4 episode of Dynamite.

stories.title: Anarchy in the Arena match set for AEW Full Gear
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley has challenged Jay White and David Finlay's newly formed faction, The Cut, to an Anarchy in the Arena match at AEW Full Gear. The challenge was issued on the Fright Night episode of Dynamite after Moxley and Daniel Garcia lost an opening tag team match due to outside interference. A massive post-match brawl ensued, prompting Moxley to lay out the violent stipulation to settle the feud between the two groups. While the match awaits official confirmation from the promotion, it promises to be a chaotic showdown when the pay-per-view takes place in Phoenix on November 14.

stories.title: Toni Storm AEW return updates and teases
stories.tldr: AEW has begun teasing the eventual return of Timeless Toni Storm through a series of mysterious cassette tapes distributed to media members at WrestleDream. However, backstage reports indicate that her actual in-ring return is not imminent, as she has been out of action since March 2026 following a backstage attack. While creative plans are underway to flesh out the mystery of her attacker and possibly introduce non-wrestling storyline elements, her exact comeback date remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov announced for AEW Fright Night Collision
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling has announced a loaded four-match lineup for this Saturday's special Halloween edition of Fright Night Collision, taped in St. Louis. The card is highlighted by Ilja Dragunov competing in his second AEW match against The Beast Mortos as he continues to make an impact following his debut. Additionally, Tommaso Ciampa will face hometown favorite Matt Sydal while dealing with tension from Dragunov, and The Conglomeration will seek revenge against the newly formed group The Cut in trios action. The broadcast will also feature the Triangle of Madness defending the Artist of STARDOM Championship against Hazuki, Koguma, and Fuwa-chan.

stories.title: Tony Khan comments on AEW ticket prices
stories.tldr: During a recent interview with First Coast News to promote the upcoming AEW Dynamite Blood and Guts special in Jacksonville, Florida, Tony Khan made a bold promise regarding live event costs. The AEW President claimed that his promotion offers the most affordable tickets in televised professional wrestling. Specifically addressing the November 4 event at the VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena, Khan joked and guaranteed that attending the high-profile show will not cost fans an arm and a leg.

stories.title: Queen Aminata praises Mercedes Mone
stories.tldr: AEW star Queen Aminata recently appeared on CMLL Informa to discuss her impactful match against AEW Women's Champion Mercedes Mone at the Grand Slam France edition of Dynamite. Aminata revealed that sharing the ring with Mone in her childhood hometown of Paris completely changed her perspective and inspired her to reach a higher level in her career. Believing that Mone does not receive enough credit for her immense talent and contributions to the industry, Aminata expressed a strong desire to face the champion in a rematch.

stories.title: Ilja Dragunov's AEW debut reactions
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ilja Dragunov has made a major splash in AEW following his debut at WrestleDream, which he described as a fairytale moment filled with nostalgia and freedom. After winning his Dynamite debut match against Speedball Bailey, Dragunov quickly moved on to his next major program by confronting Tommaso Ciampa. Ciampa had referred to himself as the greatest damn signing in AEW history, prompting Dragunov to challenge him to a match. While Ciampa initially teased a fight before declining and walking away, the confrontation has set the stage for an anticipated showdown between the two stars.

stories.title: AEW Collision viewership updates
stories.tldr: The October 24 episode of AEW Collision drew 449,000 viewers on TNT alongside a 0.10 rating in the 18 to 49 demographic. Linear television numbers showed massive growth compared to the exact same week in the previous year, nearly doubling total viewership. Meanwhile, digital engagement remained strong with high-view YouTube clips featuring top stars like Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite 10/28/2026 reviews and reports
stories.tldr: The October 28, 2026, Fright Night episode of AEW Dynamite delivered major title changes and compelling storyline developments, though it received mixed reactions regarding its holiday theme. Reviewers felt the Halloween atmosphere fell flat due to a lack of spooky stipulation matches, a result of upcoming events like Blood & Guts and strict athletic commission rules. Despite pacing concerns from a packed schedule that also saw an Anarchy in the Arena match announced for Full Gear, the show excelled with strong in-ring action, including Queen Aminata winning the TBS Championship and Darby Allin retaining the TNT title. Additionally, Kofi and Austin Creed delivered a memorable response to Swerve Strickland demanding a Texas Death match for the World Trios Championships.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli attacked on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: During the October 28, 2026 episode of AEW Dynamite, Claudio Castagnoli was brutally attacked and stretchered out following a violent brawl between The Death Riders and The Cut. The chaos escalated when David Finlay struck Castagnoli with a shillelagh and Jay White delivered a Blade Runner onto exposed concrete outside the ring. This dramatic incident leaves Castagnoli's immediate future uncertain as Jon Moxley pushes for an Anarchy in the Arena match at Full Gear.

stories.title: Bryce Remsburg on AEW running against WrestleMania
stories.tldr: AEW referee Bryce Remsburg recently addressed the possibility of AEW running a major event in the United States during the same weekend WWE WrestleMania 43 takes place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. While Tony Khan has noted it is something to consider, Remsburg confirmed that internal conversations are currently taking place regarding potential plans for that weekend. Meanwhile, WWE already expects a significant presence from AEW and has announced several local events and watch parties in New York City for that time period. Although official dates for WrestleMania 43 are not yet confirmed, the weekend of April 10 and 11 is reportedly being targeted for the event.

stories.title: Matt Hardy discusses Adam Copeland as AEW World Champion
stories.tldr: Adam Copeland has announced his plans to retire by the end of next year and wants to win the AEW World Championship before he steps away. During a recent podcast discussion, Matt Hardy expressed concern that some wrestling fans might criticize Copeland holding the belt because of his age and history with WWE. Despite these potential fan reservations, Hardy personally supports the idea and believes Copeland would use his championship reign to help elevate younger talent. Although Copeland recently came up short in a title opportunity at WrestleDream, Hardy remains optimistic that a championship run could still happen.

stories.title: Darby Allin retains TNT title against Josh Alexander
stories.tldr: Darby Allin successfully defended his TNT Championship against Josh Alexander in a brutal encounter on Fright Night Dynamite. The match featured trademark high-risk carnage, including a vicious leaping tombstone piledriver through two chairs on the outside. Allin ultimately secured the victory after outside interference from the heels was thwarted by a disguised Steven Borden. Borden then declared his intention to enter the upcoming Blood and Guts match alongside the champion.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns vs. FTR series update
stories.tldr: The best-of-five series between FTR and the Motor City Machine Guns has shifted following their latest encounter. During Game 3 on Dynamite, Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin secured a crucial victory to take a two to one series lead. Following the match, a handshake attempt turned violent when Stokely Hathaway blinded the Machine Guns with powder, allowing FTR to launch a vicious post-match assault.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland and Bandido feud on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland escalated his feud with Hangman Page on AEW Dynamite Fright Night by brutally attacking Bandido and unmasking him to force a Texas Death Match at Full Gear. The violent ultimatum left Brody King furious and forced the champions to rush backstage, putting immense pressure on them to accept the stipulation. Strickland later gloated about the assault on social media as the build to the November 14 pay-per-view intensifies.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite ticket sales update
stories.tldr: Ahead of tonight's broadcast from Saint Louis, AEW Dynamite has distributed 3,066 tickets, marking a modest increase of 30 since yesterday. The latest figures surpass the attendance for the company's previous television stop at the venue in late 2024. Tonight's card features high-stakes action, including the third match in the Best of Five series between the Motor City Machine Guns and FTR. Title matches are also on the docket, with Darby Allin defending the TNT Championship against Josh Alexander and Persephone putting the TBS Championship on the line against Queen Aminata.

stories.title: Darby Allin set for CMLL debut and AEW Twitch return
stories.tldr: Darby Allin is heading to Mexico City for his eagerly awaited CMLL debut against Hechicero during the Day of the Dead weekend festivities at a sold out Arena Mexico. Before this marquee non title clash, Allin will defend his TNT Championship against Josh Alexander on the October 28 Fright Night edition of Dynamite. The CMLL event will stream live via MyAEW and YouTube memberships, marking a major crossover moment for both promotions. Additionally, AEW has announced its return to platform streaming with a special Twitch integration for the November 4 Blood and Guts edition of Dynamite.

stories.title: Max Caster provides update on Anthony Bowens' AEW status and his own future
stories.tldr: Max Caster recently provided an update on his former Acclaimed partner Anthony Bowens, noting that Bowens still works for AEW following the expiration of their shared contract timeline. Caster himself has stepped away from wrestling for an undefined period after being quickly let go by TNA following a controversial rap referencing Saudi Arabia at Bound for Glory. Despite his departure and current break, Caster left the door open for a potential future return to AEW while praising Tony Khan. Bowens remains on the AEW roster and was recently spotted training at the NJPW Dojo in California.

stories.title: Tony Khan meets with Skydance team and WBD executives ahead of AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan recently traveled to Los Angeles to meet with executives from Skydance following their major media merger, leaving him feeling extremely optimistic about the future of the promotion. Khan expressed great excitement regarding his talks with Skydance leadership, including head David Ellison, who reportedly supports AEW's continued growth under the new corporate banner. Additionally, WBD executives are scheduled to be in attendance for the upcoming annual Fright Night edition of AEW Dynamite in St. Louis.

stories.title: Danhausen hosts Halloween special
stories.tldr: Professional wrestling personality Danhausen is hosting a special Halloween-themed entertainment event for fans. The broadcast features a spooky laboratory setting where Danhausen welcomes viewers into his world. The program includes a lineup of frightening matches, appearances by scary Superstars, and various special guest appearances to celebrate the holiday season.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher credits The Miz as an in-ring influence
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently revealed that WWE veteran The Miz serves as a major influence on his promo style. Speaking on a recent podcast, Fletcher praised The Miz for his ability to read and react to the live crowd rather than relying on heavily scripted or memorized material. This spontaneous approach has inspired Fletcher to trust his own speaking abilities more as he continues to develop his heel persona within The Don Callis Family.

stories.title: AEW wrestlers reportedly resisting taking TV losses
stories.tldr: A recent backstage report indicates that several midcard wrestlers in AEW are pushing back against taking losses on television, prioritizing their own career stock over booking angles. This reluctance reportedly extends to members of the Don Callis Family who have won zero matches this year yet still turn down pins. Consequently, some talent prefer working in Ring of Honor where they can receive actual pushes rather than appearing on Dynamite solely to lose. While established main eventers like Will Ospreay and Hangman Page easily embrace being team players, lower-card wrestlers fight to protect their futures amid concerns that expiring contracts might not be renewed.

stories.title: Darby Allin announced for CMLL debut in Mexico City
stories.tldr: AEW star Darby Allin is set to make his highly anticipated CMLL debut this Friday during the Day of Monuments weekend festivities in Mexico City. He will face reigning CMLL World Heavyweight Champion Hechicero in a marquee non-title match at a sold-out Arena Mexico. The high-profile bout serves as a preview of the ongoing rivalry between Allin and the Don Callis Family ahead of the upcoming Blood and Guts match on AEW Dynamite. Fans worldwide can stream the event live via pay-per-view on MyAEW or through the highest tier of CMLL's YouTube channel.

stories.title: Bishop Kaun reveals original plans for AEW faction The Demand
stories.tldr: Bishop Kaun revealed that he and Toa Liona forced their way into Ricochets new AEW faction, The Demand, after initially not being planned for the group. By delivering an impressive performance during a match where Ricochet was on commentary, the former AEW World Trios Champions proved they belonged and were quickly selected backstage. Kaun noted that two other wrestlers were originally supposed to take their spots, hinting that those individuals might actually be part of the stable now.

stories.title: Cash Wheeler explains why FTR re-signed with AEW over returning to WWE
stories.tldr: Cash Wheeler recently explained why FTR chose to re-sign with AEW rather than return to WWE. He highlighted AEW's premier tag team division, the excitement of helping build a relatively young company, and the vital leverage the promotion provides for industry workers. Additionally, Wheeler values the freedom to wrestle internationally in places like New Japan and Mexico while maintaining AEW as their home base.

stories.title: QT Marshall acquires partial ownership of Rome Red Cats arena football team
stories.tldr: Professional wrestler and executive QT Marshall has expanded his business portfolio by becoming a partial owner of the Rome Red Cats arena football team in Georgia. He joins his One Fall Wrestling business partner, Tripp Bennett, in the ownership group to support the team's marketing, sponsorships, and community outreach efforts. The franchise is scheduled to begin competing in the American Arena League in 2027, playing their home games at the Forum River Center in downtown Rome. Alongside this new venture, Marshall continues his work in the wrestling industry as All Elite Wrestling's senior vice president of creative coordination.
